content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Outsourced HR, payroll and workers' comp insurance for small businesses; does not process corporate payments or freight bills."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Global freight forwarding and customs brokerage moves goods; Cass audits and pays freight bills rather than arranging shipments."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Trucking and intermodal transportation owns and operates freight capacity, a different business from payment and audit services."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Mechanical, electrical and building-systems installation and maintenance; physical building services, not payment or information processing."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"B2B payment processing and accounts payable automation for businesses paying suppliers, closely matching Cass's payment services."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Contract engineering, healthcare and IT staffing bills for people's time; no payment processing or banking business."},{"label":"C7","good":true,"reason":"Integrated payment processing, bill payment and B2B payment services for businesses and institutions, overlapping Cass's payment offerings."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Insurance brokerage earning carrier commissions; does not process payments or provide banking services."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Physical cash-in-transit, ATM replenishment and security services; cash logistics differs from Cass's payment processing and bank deposits."}]}
